name: Bukit Timah
mrt: Downtown Line stops along Bukit Timah Road: Botanic Gardens, Tan Kah Kee, Sixth Avenue, King Albert Park and Beauty World
intro: Bukit Timah is mostly landed streets and low-rise condos strung along Bukit Timah Road and Dunearn Road. We bring the full mobile kit to your driveway, porch or condo basement, so a coated or freshly corrected car never has to leave home.
parking: Landed homes here usually have a driveway or car porch, which is the easiest place for a long coating job. Condos along Bukit Timah Road and Dunearn Road mostly park in sheltered basement car parks, which keep sun and rain off the paint while the coating sets.
cars: German and Japanese premium models are a common sight on these roads. On a car like that, paint correction and a long-life coating are usually what owners ask about first.
condo: Some condos ask contractors to register at the guardhouse or book a bay. Tell us your condo name when you book and we will follow its rules.
line: From Botanic Gardens up to Beauty World

name: Holland Village
label: Holland Village and Holland Road
mrt: Holland Village on the Circle Line, with Farrer Road one stop away
intro: Around Holland Village and along Holland Road, homes are a mix of landed estates such as Chip Bee Gardens and Holland Grove and condos set back from the main road. We come to your driveway or condo car park with the full mobile kit.
parking: Landed streets off Holland Road and Holland Avenue mostly have car porches or driveways. Condos along Holland Road usually have basement or sheltered car parks, which suit long coating and polishing work.
cars: Premium cars are common on Holland Road. A car parked in an open porch picks up rain and water marks on glass and paint; glass water-mark removal and coating is the package for that.
condo: If your condo asks contractors to register, send us the condo name when you book.
line: Holland Village, Holland Road and the landed estates around them

name: Sixth Avenue
mrt: Sixth Avenue station on the Downtown Line
intro: The streets around Sixth Avenue are mostly landed homes with driveways, plus a few low-rise condos off Bukit Timah Road.
parking: Most homes here have a porch or driveway, which gives room to work all around the car.

name: King Albert Park
mrt: King Albert Park station on the Downtown Line
intro: King Albert Park sits where Bukit Timah Road meets Clementi Road, with landed estates and condos on both sides of the main road.
parking: Landed homes have porches and driveways; condos nearby mostly use basement car parks.

name: Coronation Road
mrt: Farrer Road (Circle Line) and Sixth Avenue (Downtown Line) are the nearest stations
intro: Coronation Road runs off Bukit Timah Road near the Farrer Road end, with landed streets and low-rise condos around it.
parking: Expect porches and driveways on the landed streets and sheltered car parks at the condos.

name: Holland Grove
mrt: Holland Village station on the Circle Line is the nearest
intro: Holland Grove is a quiet landed estate off Holland Road, close to Holland Village.
parking: Homes here mostly have car porches, so we can work on the car where it is parked.

name: Farrer Road
mrt: Farrer Road station on the Circle Line
intro: Farrer Road links Holland Road and Bukit Timah Road, lined with condos and landed streets.
parking: Condos along Farrer Road mostly have basement or covered car parks; landed homes nearby have driveways.

name: Dunearn
mrt: Botanic Gardens, Tan Kah Kee and Sixth Avenue on the Downtown Line
intro: Dunearn Road runs alongside Bukit Timah Road, with condos fronting the road and landed streets behind them.
parking: Condos here mostly park in basements; landed homes on the side streets have porches.

name: Tanglin
mrt: Orchard Boulevard on the Thomson-East Coast Line is the nearest
intro: Tanglin, between Orchard and the Botanic Gardens, is mostly condos with a few landed streets.
parking: Most condos here have basement car parks, which keep the car shaded while a coating cures.

name: Newton
mrt: Newton station on the North-South and Downtown Lines
intro: Around Newton the homes are mostly condos, close to where Bukit Timah Road starts.
parking: Condo basements are the usual place we work here.

name: Novena
mrt: Novena station on the North-South Line
intro: Novena mixes condos along Thomson Road with landed streets on the side roads.
parking: Condos have sheltered or basement car parks; landed homes have porches.

name: Watten Estate
mrt: Tan Kah Kee and Botanic Gardens on the Downtown Line
intro: Watten Estate is a landed estate off Dunearn Road, between Bukit Timah Road and Shelford Road.
parking: Homes here have driveways and porches, so the car can stay at home for the whole job.
